profile.name: Muhammad Hussain
profile.title: Database & Software Developer
profile.subtitle: Software Engineering Student | Founder of Zorvexa | Aspiring Data Engineer
profile.bio: I build database-driven software that solves real business problems. From hotel management systems and POS applications to AI-powered synthetic data platforms, my work sits at the intersection of relational databases, backend logic, and practical software delivery. Currently pursuing BS Software Engineering at COMSATS University Islamabad while building Zorvexa — a software company focused on databases, development, and AI-enabled solutions.

projects.title: Synthora AI
projects.description: A platform that generates realistic synthetic datasets for testing and development — no real customer data needed. Supports tabular, relational, and document data with schema design, data integrity checks, and saved dataset management.
projects.role: Team Leader — Database Engineering & Schema Design

projects.title: NovaSight
projects.description: Upload CSV or Excel data and get automatic visual dashboards with KPIs, chart selection, and exportable reports. Built with database migration, session management, and AI chat integration.

projects.title: Fast Food POS
projects.description: A complete POS application built for a Sargodha fast-food business. Handles sales, cart management, product inventory, payment processing (cash, card, online), and reporting — packaged as a standalone desktop installer.

projects.title: Sarina Hotel Management System
projects.description: Desktop application managing rooms, guests, bookings, facilities, billing, staff, and departments. Demonstrates relational schema design, CRUD operations, and full application-database integration.

projects.title: Apni Wah Biryani
projects.description: System design for a food-ordering platform with customer website, admin panel, menu management, and multiple payment options (WhatsApp, Easypaisa, Cash). Includes requirements analysis, use cases, and data-flow diagrams.
